### A Prayer to Remember All God’s Wonderful Deeds
Author: Chelsey DeMatties
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-remember-all-gods-wonderful-deeds.html
Passage: Psalm 9:1
Points:
- Prayer often begins with personal struggles and requests rather than praise.
- Psalm 9:1 provides a model for orienting our hearts toward sincere thanksgiving.
- Recounting God’s past faithfulness and wonders reminds us of who He is before asking for more.
- Beginning prayer with praise acknowledges God's sufficiency and our utter dependence on Him.
